notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
The game has been updated with the following.

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some players can't progress through Mission 2
[*]Fixed a bug where the Credits can't be skipped.
[*]Improved performance on some maps/missions.
[/list]

Thank you and enjoy the game!
